candidates_considered.name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
candidates_considered.verdict: RESEARCHED, NOT PUBLISHED. Three filings read in full. (a) Subsidiary GPT Concrete Products South Africa (Pty) Ltd won a contract from the Chief Procurement Officer, Transnet Freight Rail, South Africa to manufacture railway concrete sleepers at Ladysmith, KZN: ZAR 660 million plus VAT, approximately Rs 385 crore, OVER 5 YEARS. govt_considered.release: Cabinet approves Green Energy Corridor Phase-III scheme for Development of Intra-State Transmission System with Battery Energy Storage Systems (Cabinet, PRID 2316948, 30-Sep-2026)
govt_considered.verdict: KEPT AND WORKED - the one decision in this window whose money becomes somebody's order book. Rs 1,86,405 crore as parsed from the PIB release body by our own govt.py. Mapped to the 'transmission' basket (measured history: 47 companies, median 4.7x base-to-peak against 3.0x for the market, 49% made 5x) and to 'solar_kusum'. Two names researched and both published: JYOTI STRUCTURES (transmission tower + EPC, whose FY26 annual report names Green Energy Corridors AND BESS as its demand drivers, order book Rs 2,274 cr = 2.94x FY26 income, Q1 FY27 total income +57.1%, stock -41.0% over a year) and SOLARWORLD ENERGY SOLUTIONS (257 MW / 514 MWh of NTPC BESS EPC already won at Rs 1.08-1.19 cr per MWh against the Rs 1.00 cr per MWh GEC-III implies for its 50 GWh). CAVEAT ON THE SPLIT: pib.gov.in and pmindia.gov.in are both blocked from this sandbox, so the release body was NOT re-read. A web search of the official release gives Rs 1,36,378 cr for intra-State transmission, Rs 50,000 cr for 50 GWh of BESS, central support Rs 54,082 cr, target FY2032-33, 135 GW of RE evacuation - a search summary, not a document opened, and it does not reconcile exactly (1,36,378 + 50,000 = 1,86,378 against 1,86,405, a Rs 27 cr gap).

govt_considered.release: Cabinet approves Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for Rabi Crops for Marketing Season 2027-28 (CCEA, PRID 2316941, 30-Sep-2026)
govt_considered.verdict: KEPT BY THE GATE, DISCARDED ON READING. Rs 8.36 lakh crore is the largest number in the window and it is the wrong KIND of number: farmer price support is a household/producer subsidy, which is the exact shape of PM Surya Ghar - the one basket in this repo's measured table that UNDERPERFORMED the market outright (1.8x against 2.0x). The question the playbook asks is not how big the number is but whose order book it lands in, and MSP lands in none. Also note the theme mapper tagged this release 'shipbuilding', a plain false positive, so its mapped company list is meaningless and was ignored.

govt_considered.release: Shri Chouhan Approves Rs 5,547.99 Crore Procurement of Pulses and Oilseeds Under PSS for Kharif 2026-27 (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, PRID 2316939, 30-Sep-2026)
govt_considered.verdict: KEPT BY THE GATE, DISCARDED ON READING. Price-support procurement of agricultural commodities - again a producer subsidy, not an order book, and again mis-tagged 'shipbuilding' by the theme mapper. No listed small-cap beneficiary follows from it.

govt_considered.release: Cabinet approves One Network, Smarter Traffic: Delhi Moves to Real-Time Traffic Management (CCEA, PRID 2316953, 30-Sep-2026)
govt_considered.verdict: KEPT BY THE GATE, NOT RESEARCHED. Rs 1,789.52 crore for Delhi real-time traffic management IS a procurement that becomes somebody's order book - ITMS hardware, cameras, signal controllers, software integration - and it was mapped to 'defence' and 'shipbuilding', both false positives for this subject. The honest position: this release deserves research that the run's four-name budget did not allow, and the right basket for it (urban ITMS / surveillance electronics) does not exist in theme_map.json yet. Carried to the watch list rather than silently dropped.

researched.name: Jyoti Structures Ltd
researched.reason: PUBLISHED. The government lane's primary name. Transmission tower fabrication and EPC; its own FY2026 annual report names Green Energy Corridors AND Battery Energy Storage Systems as stated demand drivers, and it has FILED completion of an intra-State 400 kV line (Gadag-II, Karnataka, 04-Mar-2026) and a 400 kV LILO at a POWERGRID substation (23-Feb-2026) - so GEC-III's asset class is documented, not inferred. Order book Rs 2,274 cr at 1-Apr-2026 = 2.94x FY26 total income, and larger than the Rs 1,974 cr it has billed in the four and a half years since its Resolution Plan. FY26 total income +53.1%, Q1 FY27 +57.1% with EBITDA +90.0% and margin up 169 bps, while the stock is -41.0% over a year at 17x trailing. 5 order filings in 760 days - between the study's measured extremes. LOW confidence, and the reason is the balance sheet and the register, not the thesis: lenders are at the NCLAT in CONTEMPT PROCEEDINGS over disbursement of NON-FUND-BASED LIMITS, which is the bank-guarantee facility an EPC contractor cannot bid without; the company has NO PROMOTER AT ALL (1,193,651,437 shares, 100.00% public across 201,951 holders - and note the dossier builder's 'promoter 100.0%' was a PARSER ERROR reading the Public row, corrected in the note); reported net profit EXCEEDS PBT in both FY26 and Q1 FY27 because insolvency losses shelter it, so headline EPS is not fully-taxed EPS; a Rights Issue II was live in June 2026; and inside four months the CEO resigned, the Chairman and Independent Director died, and an internal auditor appointed on 30-Apr-2026 was removed on 04-Aug-2026. See ideas.json 2026-10-01-JYOTISTRUC.

watch: STEEL - the commodity lane's one real development, and it cuts both ways. MetalBook's Indian prints are now dated 2026-10-01 (on 2026-09-29 the freshest were 09-14/09-16), so the Indian confirmation that was missing a week ago now exists. TMT Fe500D rose between 16-Sep and 1-Oct: Mumbai 59.9 -> 62.7 (+4.7%), Delhi 60.0 -> 62.5 (+4.2%), Bangalore 60.6 -> 63.0 (+4.0%), Raipur 56.7 -> 59.0 (+4.1%) Rs/kg, while melting scrap rose far less (Mumbai 36.5 -> 36.7, +0.5%; Raipur 37.4 -> 38.6, +3.2%). A fortnight of spread expansion. BUT over the longer window the spread COMPRESSED: since 12-Feb-2026 Mumbai TMT is +7.0% (58.6 -> 62.7) while Mumbai scrap is +9.6% (33.5 -> 36.7). So this is a two-week expansion inside a compressing trend, on series with only 10-11 readings and a gap between February and September - a watch, not a conviction. Mumbai TMT at Rs 62.7/kg is the highest of the 10 readings since 2025-07-14, which is a statement about OUR span and not an all-time high.

STEEL - the map gap behind that watch. commodity_map.json's 'steel' group lists only Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL and Jindal Steel as beneficiaries - every one outside the Rs 200-2,000 cr universe - so a confirmed domestic rebar move has NO small-cap name to research.
